replies.text:
You are right, and thank you — that was hard to type in sideways.

Three things were wrong at once. Nothing would scroll under a thumb, the keyboard was sitting on top of the buttons, and the paper was small enough that some phones zoomed the whole page when you started writing.

All three are fixed. Sideways, with the keyboard up, the box now shows just the paper and the two buttons, and everything comes back when you put the keyboard away.

Write again if it is still awkward.
